QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Looking Into the Lion King 1
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2161012##k wants to ask you something. Aren't you just dying to know what it is?!
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2161012##k says that his investigation is being bogged own by powerful monsters and strange warding spells at the Lion King's Castle. Defeat the monsters and make it through the castle, then return to #b#p2161012##k.
QuestInfo.2: Your investigation of the Lion King's Castle went well, but #b#p2161012##k seems to have more favors to ask of you.
